snippet.title: Black Parallax | Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A metroidbrainia set in a dying dwarf galaxy. Scavenge wrecks, meet strange characters, and fight your way through a cold universe to piece together an interstellar puzzle.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4126870/Black_Parallax/
Music by Alexandra Price: https://www.alexlpricemusic.com/
